patent_grounding.rationale: Candidate hardware and clamp/release operation are supported by claims and detailed passages. External supply, spring and cylinder are appropriately qualified as the dependent-claim embodiment; generic profile wording avoids asserting alternatives concurrently. Hydraulic interface/flow is directly documented.

functional_completeness.rationale: The core common claim-1 mechanism, plus expressly selected spring/hydraulic operating embodiment, is represented. Excluded positioning and air-supply mechanisms are ancillary and the candidate notes this scope.

flow_consistency.rationale: Only a hydraulic-fluid flow remains, linking compatible supply-out and cylinder-in ports. Axial-to-radial motion is correctly expressed as internal behavior rather than an incompatible interface.

claim_traceability.rationale: Model appropriately scopes its combined dependent-claim embodiment in assumptions; no invented quantitative requirements. Claims 2–5 alternative profiles remain abstracted rather than combined.

interfaces.rationale: The patent expressly supports hydraulic device-to-oil-chamber supply/discharge, represented with compatible port types. No additional unconnected flows are present. Mechanical relationships are conveyed by behavior/descriptions without asserting unsupported interface encoding.

textbook_application.rationale: Guidance distinguishes external inputs and interfaces from internal transformation. The model applies this by representing the hydraulic boundary flow and leaving axial/radial transformation internal; textbook material is not treated as invention evidence.

summary: Revision 2 addresses the previous review's concrete defects: it adds the patent-supported external hydraulic supply and connected typed ports/flow, removes disconnected mechanical/motion flows, and narrows the interface caveat. The SJS is structurally coherent, traceable, and grounded for its stated conceptual/dependent-claim scope. No repair finding is warranted.
